purpose: Declare the execution surface every packaged user skill is allowed to have. runtime-allowlist.json governs Claude agent and alias entries only; this file governs executable assets shipped inside skills.
audit_method: Python modules are parsed and their imports and call names are compared against the denied sets below. Declaring a capability here does not grant it at runtime; the platform permission mode still applies.

denied_everywhere.rationale: A packaged skill must not reach the network, install packages, or execute code it assembled at runtime. Those capabilities cannot be reviewed once the plugin is installed.

skills.writes: Only files the user explicitly approves. Proposal-only by default.
skills.note: Deterministic guard for protected tokens and change rate.

skills.interpreter: python3 with system Git, OpenSSH ssh-keygen and platform-local hook shell
skills.writes: Only the explicitly selected project's access-control bundle, provider CODEOWNERS files, managed instruction blocks, host hook configuration, local Git config/hooks, and the administrator's harness-kit key store after plan review and approval.
skills.note: The skill does not call provider APIs. Server-side branch protection stays an external administrator step. Every generated policy is signed and verified locally.

skills.writes: Only under an explicitly provided output directory, and only when the user asks to persist. Existing files are not overwritten without --force.
skills.asset_resolution: Path(__file__) relative. No plugin-root environment variable and no platform-specific skill path.
skills.note: Local CSV search over the bundled design database. All data ships with the skill; nothing is fetched.

skills.writes: Only files the user explicitly approves.

interpreter_policy.on_missing: Tell the user how to install Python and continue with a reduced, clearly-labelled result. Never install an interpreter or any package automatically.

frontmatter_policy.rationale: Shell execution is left to the platform permission mode rather than pre-approved in shared skill frontmatter.
